pack.name: ReLight Vanilla
pack.description: Flagship VSL 2.0 vanilla-faithful shader pack with blackbody dynamic lighting, vanilla-preserving incandescent lava, interactive water waves, volumetric aurora, and native SPIR-V tiled lighting.

debug_view.label: Shader Debug View
debug_view.description: Display internal render targets instead of the final image.

restir_gi.label: ReSTIR Indirect GI
restir_gi.description: Reuse first-bounce diffuse samples over time to reduce path-traced indirect-light noise.

sun_intensity.label: Sun Intensity
sun_intensity.description: Direct solar irradiance multiplier for sunlight and sky lighting.

fog_density.label: Atmospheric Fog Density
fog_density.description: Base density of distance and volumetric atmospheric fog.

water_wave_strength.label: Water Wave Strength
water_wave_strength.description: Amplitude of animated surface waves and normal perturbation on water.

tone_mapping.label: Tone Mapping
tone_mapping.description: HDR-to-display tone mapping curve applied during final color grading.

torch_intensity.label: Torch & Dynamic Light Strength
torch_intensity.description: Emission multiplier for torches, lanterns, and dynamic block lights.

godrays_intensity.label: RT Volumetric God Rays
godrays_intensity.description: Strength of volumetric light shafts through air and fog.

gi_bounce_strength.label: Path-Traced GI Bounce
gi_bounce_strength.description: Intensity of indirect multi-bounce global illumination.

wetness_strength.label: Rain Wetness & Puddles
wetness_strength.description: Surface darkening, specular sheen, and puddle reflection strength during rain.

pom_depth.label: Parallax Occlusion Depth
pom_depth.description: Height-map parallax occlusion depth on PBR textures (0 disables POM for best FPS).

pt_max_bounces.label: Path Tracing Max Bounces
pt_max_bounces.description: Maximum indirect ray bounce depth for Tier 3 path tracing. Higher values increase GPU cost.

enable_wind.label: Foliage Wind
enable_wind.description: Enables vertex wind sway animation on leaves, grass, and crops.

lava_glow.label: Lava Glow
lava_glow.description: Emission multiplier for molten vanilla lava channels, magma blocks, and thermal bloom.

lava_flow_speed.label: Lava Flow Speed
lava_flow_speed.description: Animation speed of convective thermal pulses and incandescent shimmer on lava.

low.label: Low
low.description: Performance-focused ReLight Vanilla profile with foliage wind disabled, lighter mist, and single-bounce path tracing.

medium.label: Medium
medium.description: Balanced visuals and frame rate with smooth foliage breeze, gentle valley mist, and single-bounce path tracing.

high.label: High
high.description: Default ReLight Vanilla profile with PBR Neutral color fidelity, interactive water, volumetric aurora, and two-bounce path tracing.

ultra.label: Ultra
ultra.description: Maximum visual fidelity with POM relief, rich atmospheric scattering, dynamic water effects, and deep multi-bounce path tracing.
